name: Akagawa Jirou: Yasoukyoku 2
source:
This adventure game is also adapted from Akagawa Jirou's classic mystery novel Yasoukyoku and this sequel contains three separate detective stories. The stage is set in a Library, a mansion hidden in a small town where a collection of books related to death are stored. 

[from [url=http://ks353422.kimsufi.com/databasepsx/games/J/A/SLPS-03213.html]PlayStation DataCenter[/url]]
translation:
这款冒险游戏同样改编自赤川次郎的经典悬疑小说《野战曲》，续作包含三个独立的侦探故事。舞台设置在一座图书馆，这是一座隐藏在小镇中的豪宅，里面存放着与死亡有关的书籍。

[来自[url=http://ks353422.kimsufi.com/databasepsx/games/J/A/SLPS-03213.html]PlayStation DataCenter[/url]]
